About us

Cantapueblo is organized by a small team, with more than 35 years of work behind it. These are the people leading the festival.

Alejandro Scarpetta

Founder and Artistic Director

He founded Cantapueblo in 1989 and has led it ever since.

León Repetur

Co-founder

Cultural manager, consultant and social communicator. He co-founded Cantapueblo alongside Alejandro Scarpetta, with whom he co-directs Fundación COPPLA. He was Director of Culture for the Municipality of Godoy Cruz and Deputy Secretary of Culture for the Government of Mendoza.

Gustavo Aguilera

Executive Producer

Senior Technician in Sociocultural Management and educator. He has been Cantapueblo's Executive Producer since 2006, and General Coordinator of Cantapueblo Niños since its first edition. He is the founding president of the Gestores Culturales de Mendoza association.

Cantapueblo · Fundación COPPLA

Mendoza, Argentina — international choral gathering since 1989.
